Copyright remains with the original vendor (uGeek); stored here for reference only.

Key points from the user guide: button functions (Up = repeat one song, Down = shuffle, Home = back to menu, Pause = play/pause, X = cancel, + / - = volume, plus Clock on/off and OK/playing queue), and interfaces (micro-USB charging, micro-SD slot, headphone jack, power on/off switch, mini-HDMI, micro-USB data).
